# Deviload 2.18.0

**Mix like a DJ, look back at your week, and keep your library in order.** Devil Music can blend one song into the next on the beat, tells the story of your week and your month, and the library now follows your files when they move or go missing. The whole app takes on the liquid glass of Devil Music.

- DJ mix: the end of the song playing and the start of the next are analysed for their beat. The next song comes in on a beat at the same tempo, takes over the bass halfway and eases back to its own tempo. Songs without a steady beat, or too far apart in tempo, fade as before. Turn it on in More on the player bar.
- Devil Wrapped: your week or your month in music as a vertical story with its dates, minutes, top songs and artists and your biggest day, ready to save as a picture or a video. A new one is ready at the end of every week and every month, and the Week and Month tabs of your listening open it any time.
- Move downloads to another folder from the library and keep them there, cover and subtitles included. When you change the download folder, Deviload offers to move what is already downloaded. Thanks for asking in #40.
- Missing files are marked in the library with three choices: find the file, download it again or remove the entry. A clean-up removes every missing entry at once. Thanks for asking in #40.
- Organize media offers the collections and tags you already use instead of the browser's saved info, and the Watching button for monitored playlists sits beside the queue search. Thanks for asking in #40.

### Devil Music

Songs that cannot play are faded in lists. Chinese lyrics can show pinyin, your music profile is backed up once a week, and artists known to be made by AI can be kept out of recommendations and radio. The timeline knob turns into a glass lens while you drag it. Identify song is a round button that shows it listening, and the recently identified songs and recent searches can be cleared with a bin.

### The whole app

Liquid glass on buttons, menus and cards outside Devil Music too, with glass tooltips. The sidebar folds to a column of icons, the interface size can be set in Appearance, every download shows the time left, and the taskbar icon fills while downloads run.

### Fixes

A song fading out is no longer cut short when the next one is prepared. OpenRGB runs in the background without its own icon in the tray. The release builds for Windows, macOS and Linux now run side by side.

On Windows, run the setup EXE over your installed copy to keep your library and settings.
